purpose: dual-netspeed 第一次實跑的 B 段 (design.md 第7節: A 段成功才跑這段): both instances launch and log in, host creates a PvE room, joiner joins it and readies up -- then BOTH leave the room (single-client leave_room, focused explicitly per instance since it takes no client_id -- see actions.py) and close, same self-terminating rule as -a.json. Covers join_room/set_ready/idle_nudge beyond what -a.json tested. Does NOT touch host_start_battle/enter_battle/console_cmd_on/leave_battle -- those are C段 only. REVISED 2026-09-21 after B段's actual first run: that run's join_room double-clicked the old ROOM_LIST_FIRST_ROW_CLICK (920,310), missed the room row (see actions.py's comment on that constant for the re-measurement from the failing run's own precondition screenshot), waited the old 45s DEFAULT_JOIN_ROOM_TIMEOUT_S for nothing, and the host -- which had had ZERO input since create_pve_room's Create_CQ, because idle_nudge(host) was scheduled AFTER join_room -- self-left via its own AFK timer at exactly 60,022ms (session log: Create_CQ at ms=39285630, host's own Leave_CQC at ms=39345652; see LEAVE_CQ_OPCODE's comment in actions.py, this is 60s measured, not design.md L5's ~80s estimate). Two fixes here: (1) ROOM_LIST_FIRST_ROW_CLICK corrected, DEFAULT_JOIN_ROOM_TIMEOUT_S 45->20 (a correct click's Enter_SA is a fast round trip; waiting longer only burns the room's own AFK budget for a signal that a miss will never produce); (2) idle_nudge(host) MOVED to right after create_pve_room (host is already focused there, so it's nearly free) and a SECOND idle_nudge(host) added right after join_room succeeds, before set_ready -- splitting the host's no-input span into three windows, each bounded below by summing actions.py's own timeout constants for every step inside it (focus_client switches assumed ~5s each, since actions.py has no constant for a normal-case switch -- its only declared ceiling is FOCUS_FOREGROUND_READBACK_TIMEOUT_S=25s, which is a failure-retry ceiling: a switch that slow means the action itself is already failing and the script halts, so it is not counted here; flagged as this budget's one residual risk): window A (Create_CQ -> idle_nudge#1) = create_pve_room's own confirm wait_for ceiling 10s + idle_nudge's focus_client(host, already foreground) ~5s + wiggle <1s ~= 16s; window B (idle_nudge#1 -> idle_nudge#2, spans all of join_room) = focus_client(joiner) ~5s + join_room's single-shot precondition ~2s + wait_for_log_pkts(Enter_SA) ceiling 20s (the value just lowered) + wait_for(join_room-room) ceiling 10s + focus_client(host) ~5s + wiggle <1s ~= 43s; window C (idle_nudge#2 -> host's own deliberate leave_room, i.e. this script's OWN Leave_CQC, not an AFK kick) = focus_client(joiner) ~5s + set_ready's precondition ~2s + wait_for_log_pkts(User_State_SN) ceiling 20s + its result screenshot ~1s + leave_room(joiner)'s precondition ~2s + its wait_for(lobby) ceiling 8s + focus_client(host) ~5s + leave_room(host)'s precondition ~2s ~= 45s. All three stay under the measured 60s ceiling with margin (44s/17s/15s respectively) -- window B and C's ~15-17s margin is not large, see this experiment's own risk note below. Success = result PASS: join_room's ENTER_SA send pkt and set_ready's User_State_SN send pkt both show up (conn-filtered) in their step detail, both idle_nudge steps report ok (no premature Leave_CQ), both leave_room steps land on screen=lobby, both close_client steps report the process gone. If it halts, look first at join_room (ROOM_LIST_FIRST_ROW_CLICK is now a re-measured but still UNCONFIRMED coordinate -- it has not yet been click-tested) and, if that passes, at idle_nudge/set_ready for a Leave_CQ appearing before set_ready's own pkt (would mean the ~5s focus_client assumption above was wrong for this run).
